story_zh: 爷爷年轻时是京剧演员。今天，他打扮成帅气的角色，戴眼镜表演。他的动作精彩，观众很感动。孙子小明说：“爷爷，我表扬您！您的艺术演出让我心情幸福。”爷爷幽默地笑了：“谢谢，但别让我笑死呀！”
story_pinyin: Yéye niánqīng shí shì jīngjù yǎnyuán. Jīntiān, tā dǎbàn chéng shuàiqì de juésè, dài yǎnjìng biǎoyǎn. Tā de dòngzuò jīngcǎi, guānzhòng hěn gǎndòng. Sūnzi Xiǎo Míng shuō: “Yéye, wǒ biǎoyáng nín! Nín de yìshù yǎnchū ràng wǒ xīnqíng xìngfú.” Yéye yōumò de xiào le: “Xièxie, dàn bié ràng wǒ xiào sǐ ya!”
story_en: Grandpa was a Peking opera actor when he was young. Today, he dressed up as a handsome character and performed wearing glasses. His movements were wonderful, and the audience was moved. Grandson Xiao Ming said, "Grandpa, I praise you! Your artistic performance makes me feel happy." Grandpa laughed humorously: "Thank you, but don't make me die laughing!"
